subject.title: Dashboard: approvals-queue widget (deliver #72545 as a dashboard builtin)

question: Should the pending-approvals Web GUI surface be owned by the existing approvals-dashboard issue, by this modular-dashboard builtin, or deferred until the dashboard plugin series lands?
rationale: Current main has approval queue plumbing but not the requested dashboard widget, and the proposed location depends on an unmerged dashboard plugin series plus a security-sensitive approve/deny UI surface.

options.title: Use existing approvals issue as canonical
options.body: Keep the Web GUI approval recovery surface tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72545 and treat this dashboard-widget issue as implementation context.

options.title: Sponsor the dashboard builtin roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical dashboard-specific follow-up after the modular-dashboard substrate lands.

options.title: Defer dashboard approval actions
options.body: Leave approval actions in the existing modal/RPC surfaces until maintainers approve the broader dashboard plugin direction.

recommendation.title: Use existing approvals issue as canonical
recommendation.body: Keep the Web GUI approval recovery surface tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72545 and treat this dashboard-widget issue as implementation context.

likelyOwner.reason: Current approval/security surface history is the strongest signal for deciding how a new Web approval action surface should preserve existing safeguards.
